description: Seizures occurred 18 months prior instead of 1 year prior
presentation: A 68-year-old woman with stage IV BRAF-positive metastatic melanoma on dabrafenib/trametinib and anti-seizure therapy presents to clinic after cycle 3 nivolumab infusion 5 days ago, where she developed a grade 3 infusion reaction at the end of her infusion. She has a history of seizures that occurred 18 months prior. She experienced nausea/vomiting, cyanotic hands, diffuse rash, bradycardia and tachycardia, fluctuating blood pressures, rigors, and diarrhea. All symptoms self-resolved. Her next nivolumab dose is scheduled in less than 2 weeks. Patient and family would like to proceed with treatment if safe, as there are no other treatment alternatives. Can the patient continue immunotherapy?
